text: hana: FYI I opened a PR for a compact dashboard view that tightens chart gutters and adds an 'extreme-highlighting' mode for single-line sparklines. Looking for quick design + a11y feedback. liam: Sweet. Two immediate worries: 1) when smoothing is on the visual peaks are softened and extremes can be missed; 2) legends in compact mode sometimes drop labels when width is tight. hana: Good call. For the first, my proposal: leave smoothing as a display toggle, but compute and render extremes from raw data. Visual treatment = subtle band for percentile range + optional point markers for anomalies. omar: From engineering: we can emit rawIndices alongside smoothedPoints in the chart driver. Rendering an extra dot layer is cheap, overlay band is also fine if we use composited layers. Concern: too many markers (noisy series) will clutter. rachel: UX: agree with an adaptive rule. If anomalies > 6 in view, hide per-point markers and show a summary chip in the legend like "7 extremes" with hover details. That keeps the sparkline clean. liam: Legend behavior: in compact mode space is limited. Could switch to an overflow menu that lists series with their latest stat and an action to expand. Avoid truncating labels mid-word. accessibility-bot: a11y checklist: ensure all interactive legend items have role="button" and aria-pressed, sparklines must have an accessible name (aria-label) and a live region for summary, and color-only encodings must have patterns or shapes. omar: Implementation detail: expose an API flag `renderAnomalies: rawPoints|smoothedPoints|both` and `anomalyThresholdPercentile: number`. Default = rawPoints + 90. We'll add rate limits to markers to avoid >50 markers per chart. hana: Copy suggestion for settings: instead of "Extreme highlighting" use "Highlight top percentile" and show the selected percentile inline e.g. "Highlight top percentile (90%)". Also add a tooltip: "Detects points above Xth percentile of visible range." rachel: Tooltip microcopy: when overlay is active, show "value (raw)" and when smoothing is active show both "value (raw)" and "value (smoothed)" lines. Helps analysts understand differences. liam: Keyboard/announcements: when a user tabs to a sparkline, announce "Sparkline for : min 2ms, median 10ms, max 180ms. 2 points above 90th percentile. Press Enter for details." Also add a focus-visible halo for markers. hana: Design for marker: small hollow circle 3px radius, 2px stroke in warning token, 6px hit target on hover/focus. For dense charts use a tiny vertical bar instead of circle to avoid overlap. omar: PR link: added rawIndices export and marker layer. I'll implement the marker cap and overflow chip. rachel: Figma updated with examples for 0, 3, and 12 anomalies and compact legend overflow state . Left a note on spacing tokens. accessibility-bot: sample aria markup suggestion: ``` ``` and for interactive legend items: `button[aria-pressed]` and `aria-describedby` pointing to anomaly-count. hana: Acceptance criteria I'll add to the ticket: default = raw-based highlighting on; markers shown when anomalies <=6; overflow chip otherwise; legend items with aria-pressed; tooltips show raw/smoothed labeling; percentiles configurable in advanced settings; perf note to use composited layers. liam: small nit: settings copy should be "Highlight top percentile (90%)" not "(90th)" to be less jargony. rachel: +1. Also let's ensure color token meets 3:1 contrast in small UI chips. hana: Thanks all. I'll update the PR and ping for a final pass before merge. omar: :shipit: when tests pass.
